Introducing

The Flexia Smart Reformer

Our studio-grade Smart Reformer is artfully engineered for your home, using aluminum alloy and solid Cherry hardwood for longevity, stability, and timeless design. Each reformer comes with sensors embedded beneath the carriage to track your movement during classes in our Online Studio. Get real-time feedback on your Pilates workout from the comfort of home.

Smart Reformer & All-In Bundle

Ready to go all-in with your Pilates practice? This option allows you to experience all the classes and exercise variations in our amazing connected Online Studio - including cardio jumpboard classes, advanced flows, and more! 

SHOP OUR SALE

On-Demand, Expert-Led Classes

Enjoy the convenience of a Pilates practice at home. Choose from our library of on-demand classes, with varied levels, intensities, and class focuses, to get the most out of your Pilates practice--no RSVP required.

More than just a reformer...more than just an Online Studio

The Flexia Smart Reformer is equipped with sensors to track the 3 metrics that matter most in Pilates: Control, Speed, and Consistency, to give you your best Pilates workout yet.

Try in Home for 30 Days

Take 30 days to fall in love with your Flexia Smart Reformer or we'll come pick it up.

Upright Storage

The Flexia Reformer fits in an 2.5' x 3' x 8' space when upright; while in use, our recommended footprint is 9.5' x 6.5'.

Enhance your Pilates practice with metrics that matter

Here's a deep dive into these metrics, which you'll see real-time feedback with, using our Online Studio with your Flexia Smart Reformer:

  • Control: This metric measures your carriage travel over time, during a single rep, ensuring you're moving with the verbal cues of your instructor.
  • Speed: We'll measure the tempo at which you move so you get the most out of each rep. Remember, it’s not a race. Often with Pilates, slower is better.
  • Consistency: Measures your ability to perform your 6th rep as well as your 1st.
